prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE refined Minecraft mod machine UI mockup based on the attached actual Smithy screenshot (layout/interaction reference) and approved cabinet concept (palette and detailed frame reference). This is an icon recipe-browser redesign, not a redesign of the processing machine. One centered close-up screen over a dim softly blurred Minecraft workshop, large enough to judge UI. Native Minecraft pixel art, item sprites and text. Soft slightly dark tan enamel, fine charcoal metal bevels, nicely shaded tiny brass corner rivets, restrained Tesla-era scientific workshop theme. No decorative gears.
Main Smithy panel on right: brass "Smithy" nameplate, four material slots, short progress arrow, one output slot; two coal slots with flame window; player inventory below. Show selected Iron Pickaxe as ghost output; inputs ghost 3 iron ingots, 1 leather, 2 sticks and one empty slot. Small "Add materials" status. Ghosts are translucent desaturated recognizable item icons. Inventory can be sparsely filled. Preserve native square slots.
Attached narrower recipe drawer left: REMOVE all large text buttons completely. Along the drawer's OUTER left edge a vertical set of five small native square icon tabs: all-recipes grid icon, pickaxe for tools (selected with subtle brass border), sword for weapons, chestplate for armor, cog/machine-part for components. Inside drawer at top: compact search field with magnifying glass and faint "Search". Next one row of five small icon-only material chips: all-materials dotted grid, iron ingot SELECTED, gold ingot, diamond, dark netherite ingot. Below, tiny breadcrumb text "Tools / Iron" makes the two selected filters unambiguous. Recipe body: a compact THREE-COLUMN TWO-ROW grid of exactly SIX attractive native item-icon tiles, no word buttons: iron pickaxe, iron axe, iron shovel, iron hoe, iron saw, shears. Pickaxe tile has warm thin brass selection frame; other tiles simple recessed gray-tan backgrounds. Items centered with generous one-pixel-style padding, usual Minecraft slot-sized icons. Do not draw diamonds or gold tools among these six iron results. Use a thin modest scrollbar if necessary, not oversized navigation controls. Under grid show small selected name "Iron Pickaxe", no giant description card. Bottom toolbar: two small icon controls only, circular arrows for Automatic and anvil for Repair; small quiet footer text "6 recipes". These are distinct mode/actions, not recipes in the result grid. No giant Automatic button, no Repair text button, no repeated recipe text list.
Everything should look immediately implementable with native Minecraft slots, tabs, tooltip interactions and our existing shared cabinet skin. Readability and hierarchy without clutter: categories vertically, material choices horizontally, items in a simple grid. Only one concept, no inset, labels outside UI, arrows explaining layout, or promotional text. Keep the drawer compact; it should take less width than the main machine panel. Selected recipe does not itself craft or buy anything.
review: Accepted as a concept: clear category tabs, contextual material row, six icon results and existing cabinet styling. Implementation should use native slot-sized recipe tiles (the illustration enlarges them), actual item sprites and translucent input ghosts. Hide irrelevant category/material filters for simple machines, and omit scrolling when all results fit. No runtime UI or recipe changes.
